scope: Protected helper generations isolated from peer state left by an earlier client on a reused UDP endpoint

source_identity.kind: exact source-file SHA-256; no source commit association asserted

defect.observed: Against the software-build coap-server, 300 sequential Observe receiver-death generations failed between cycles 54 and 296 with security_handshake_failed or timeout
defect.peer_trace: On owner EOF the helper sent its best-effort Observe cancellation and exited at once. The peer answered with an empty ACK and a separate confirmable response, retransmitted it toward the dead endpoint, and queued the next generation's response behind it when the operating system reused that UDP port
contributing_causes: libcoap starts client tokens at a counter value of one, so every generation's first request used token 0x01
The worker ended the active exchange on COAP_EVENT_OSCORE_NO_SECURITY, which libcoap raises for a response token with no request association

assertions: Exit cleanup keeps servicing the exchange for at most 20 ms, inside custody's 25 ms termination signal, until the cancellation response is processed and acknowledged
Through an ExUnit UDP relay, every confirmable peer message after receiver death has an ACK or RST with its message ID before the helper exits; the preceding helper left peer CON 1672 unacknowledged
Each session seeds libcoap's token counter with 8 bytes from OpenSSL RAND_bytes; the native harness requires a first request token of at least 5 bytes, which the preceding helper failed with 0x01

A relayed confirmable 2.05 with an empty OSCORE option and an unused token, delivered before the real response, leaves the active protected GET successful; the preceding helper returned security_handshake_failed
Undecryptable responses correlated to the active request still end it with security_handshake_failed
Three development runs of 300 sequential Observe receiver-death generations passed with 297 to 300 distinct helper source ports observed

lanes.command: WOTEX_PATH_DEPS=1 OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR=/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3 mix wotex.software.build --workspace "$ABSOLUTE_EMPTY_WORKSPACE"; then mix wotex.software.run with the same OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR
docker build -f Dockerfile -t wotex-coap-agent-native:stale CONTEXT (native/oscore sources, patches, yyjson, test/native sources and the pinned archive as source.tar.gz)

unaccepted: Unprotected nonempty responses are still rejected before token correlation by the response-admission patch and end the active exchange
An abruptly killed helper cannot acknowledge a pending peer response; a later generation on the same endpoint can still wait behind that peer retransmission
The 300-generation repetition is development evidence; the committed stress lane remains separate work
